race.comment: Big field and tough race complicated by the draws. VINO MISS (10) is a three-start maiden with plenty of ability. On speed and fought on well fresh to finish fourth but hit the line powerfully at previous two starts. May well have to do that here as she's drawn wide but looks tough to beat with any luck from the gate. CHAMPAGNE TALKS (9) showed early speed from a good draw and boxed on well for third and beaten 1.2 lengths over 1200m at Belmont Park. Drawn wide but close to a win and will give a sight. JEWEL OF ZAVALA (11) is back from a long break. Raced three times last time in and her form is much better than it appears. Expected to run well. PLAYA DEL SOL (7) is fitter and will give a sight off the low draw. HAMADRYAD (8) was close to the winner when fifth last time and should be at her top after two runs back.
